configProvenance.note: Stored-vs-effective record for the Handoff §1 scoring-knob whitelist. The master's Comps row leaves several knobs EMPTY (Jet null recorded faithfully as null above; DB-wide unset on all 168 rows), so stored config cannot prove scoring-time behaviour. Where a definite value matters downstream (the rounding grid, the normalisation basis), the arithmetic-verified effective value is given here next to the verbatim stored state. The full row exactly as extracted (including its mixed ''/null conventions) sits in compsRowVerbatim.

GroupScoreOption.basis: reconstructed from arithmetic: every one of the 33 scored round-groups normalises on RawScore points-basis (winner maps to exactly 1000.0 even where the winner holds landing points - 32 of 33 groups - which rules out the option-2 landing-after-time mechanism); corroborated by GS guarded-reload DBNull fallback option->1 (GlobalFunctions_MOD.vb:1564-1580)

GroupScoreDecimals.basis: reconstructed from arithmetic: all 162 positive NormalisedScore values match half-up rounding of 1000*Raw/group-max to exactly 1 dp and none match truncation or any other grid; persisted at 1 dp despite Decs being unset; corroborated by the new-comp factory default GroupScoreDecimals=1 (CompNew.vb:692-693)

RoundOrTruncate.basis: stored present (0 = rounded); consistent with the none-match-truncation finding

DropScoreOption.basis: stored empty reads as 0 (drop worst task scores); moot while thresholds never activate

Drop1AtRound.basis: unset; story notes drop config unset DB-wide => NO drops fire anywhere in this corpus batch

GSCompClass.basis: recovered var-text; corroborated by comp name and F5J-shaped Dur config (durRefHeight/motor-restart field)

configProvenance.effective-drop-conclusion: With Drop1/Drop2 unset and Drop3-5 = 99 (= never), no drop-worst can activate within rounds 1-11; recorded explicitly rather than assumed from UI defaults.

teams.evidence: Scores carries no team columns at all; team standings are report-time aggregations of unchanged individual normalised scores, never an input to them. UseTeams=true with UseTeamProtection=true is an app-level default set on every Comps row in this master DB, not a real assignment: all 18 CompPilots carry Team='0' (zero populated teams), NbrForTeamScore=2 is a stored default, and team data reaches no persisted score.

compsRowVerbatim.conventionsNote: Verbatim extraction of the single Comps row (40 columns) with its inherent convention mix: Jet-nulls in fixed-length columns appear as "" (machinery encodings retained by the degraded assembly); UseRegistration carries JSON null because it was read through the patched path; the 12 variable-length Text columns are recovered (byte-validated) values, not parser output. 'NotRecorded' in WasLastUploadPublic is the literal stored text. See extract/comps-field-provenance.json for per-column recovery method.
